tooltip.zh_CN: 每名正在工作的科研专家额外提供2点基础大科学家点数，并受到其它伟人点数百分比加成。本城学院区域及其每一级建筑各提供1点住房。

tooltip.zh_CN: 本城学院以外的合格专业区域，将基础相邻产出总和的50%转化为科技值。只计算已完成且未被掠夺的区域；不计政策等相邻倍率或其它非相邻产出。适用区域见专业领域表。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Science=0.5 * sum(BASE adjacency yields from qualified non-Campus districts in district_qualification); no actual/final yields.
abilities.notes_compatibility: 不沿用旧Research IV所有非Campus区域Actual复制范围，不处理精度实现。

tooltip.zh_CN: 每名正在工作的科研专家，从本城每个合格的其它专业领域获得对应产出。该领域每有1点区域完善度，便提供0.5份对应产出；金币每份为3点，其它产出每份为1点。同产出领域分别计算并相加，同领域多个区域取最高单区域完善度。

abilities.mechanical_contract: For each qualified non-Campus domain d, D_d=Shared_D0028 DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT (maximum single eligible district, cap10). Per working Research specialist, shares_d=K*D_d with K_current=0.5; convert via existing yield_mapping value_multiplier (Gold3, others1); same yield from different domains adds. No district-type-count X multiplier; no Design rounding.
abilities.notes_compatibility: Existing domain eligibility/mapping retained; excludes Campus. Shared completed/nonpillaged ordinary-building predicate and cap10 apply. Unknown types excluded and reported. K is explicit provisional balance value; old X-count formula superseded.

tooltip.zh_CN: 学院每有1点区域完善度，每名正在工作的科研专家额外提供1点基础科技值。区域完善度最高10点；达到10点时，5名专家共增加50点基础科技值。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Per working Research specialist: additional base Science = Campus domain DISTRICT_DEVELOPMENT (Shared_D0028.json); cap10, maximum single Campus if multiple; no building Science feedback.
abilities.notes_compatibility: D0028 supersedes uncapped Infrastructure Value; ordinary tier contributions and pillage rules centrally defined in Shared.

tooltip.zh_CN: 每名正在工作的科研专家，使本城每座普通学院一至四级建筑额外提供1点基础科技值。被掠夺的建筑不计入，也不接受此收益。这些额外科技不会提高区域完善度。

abilities.mechanical_contract: Per eligible ordinary Campus tier1–4 building (Shared BUILDING_CURRENT_ELIGIBILITY), extra base Science=working Campus specialists. Multiple buildings count individually. Extra Science never changes DistrictDevelopment.
abilities.notes_compatibility: Building count is not capped by D; only Infrastructure ability uses capped D. No recursive feedback.

tooltip.zh_CN: 本城首次达到科研专业潜力4级后，学术传统开始积累：起始使本城科技值提高5%；标准速度下，满10、20、30、40回合分别提高至10%、15%、20%、25%，最高25%。其它速度按游戏速度同比缩放各阶段回合数并向下取整。仍保有科研专业身份时，即使暂未启用4级能力，传统仍继续积累。转出科研后停止积累但保留已累计年限；重新成为科研时继续积累，不补算离开期间的回合。启用4级能力后按保留的传统年限生效。

abilities.mechanical_contract: s=game speed turn-length multiplier relative to Standard; age=accumulated turns retaining Research Identity after first permanent Research Potential4. ACTIVE changes do not pause accumulation while Research Identity remains. Losing Research Identity (including REALLOCATING when Research Identity is lost) pauses age without deleting it; returning to Research resumes from retained age without credit for time outside Research. Thresholds=floor(10*s),floor(20*s),floor(30*s),floor(40*s), calculated independently from unrounded values. Tier=max({0} union {j in 1..4 where age>=floor(10*j*s)}); bonusPercent=5*(1+Tier), cap25. Apply only ACTIVE>=4. Never floor s first or multiply a rounded 10-turn threshold.

abilities.notes_compatibility: 制度年龄不受专家连续工作或总督连续驻扎影响。未来具体速度数据接口由Architecture评估；不改Crew或其它机制的速度合同。
